bio: A skilled and curious tech enthusiast with hands-on experience in designing and developing user interfaces and a strong interest in exploring diverse areas of technology. Continuously stays updated with emerging trends by participating in workshops and technical learning opportunities, while actively experimenting with new tools and frameworks. Driven by a passion for solving real-world problems through technology, with a growing focus on fields such as Web Development and Generative AI. Dedicated to building innovative, efficient, and user-friendly digital solutions while constantly expanding technical knowledge and practical experience.
metaDescription: Krishna Vijay G (Arkhins) is a full-stack developer and designer in Chennai who ships production web platforms for motorsport, education and finance.
